documents.summary: An extended sandstone day combining both Tisá wall circuits with the broader table-mountain views of Děčínský Sněžník.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The longer circuit combines intimate sandstone passages with a genuinely different table-mountain finish.

documents.name: Oslava: Náměšť–Lamberk–Kraví Hora traverse
documents.summary: A long railway-to-railway traverse through the wild Oslava valley, linking riverside paths, two atmospheric castle ruins, old mill landscapes and repeated steep valley-side climbs.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A genuine A/D2 long-day hike. It is farther from Prague than the highest-return anomalies, but the length and continuity make it difficult to substitute with a shorter river outing. The point-to-point rail geometry is a feature, not a compromise.

documents.name: Lá Bù Lá
documents.summary: A focused spicy-food specialist whose strongest dishes are noodles and chilli-oil preparations.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Fermented noodles, pickled mustard greens, Sichuan pepper and layered chilli oils create a regional profile unlike generic ‘spicy Chinese’ food. Order: Lá Bù Lá beef noodles; chao shou/wontons in chilli or green pepper; smashed spicy cucumber. Why: These show the Chongqing identity and house sauces; cold dishes balance the rich broth.

documents.name: Rißlochfälle–Großer Arber ascent
documents.summary: A steep one-way climb past the Rißloch waterfalls to the highest summit of the Bavarian Forest.
documents.whyWorthwhile: It combines the region’s strongest waterfall landscape with a meaningful summit ascent; using the gondola and bus for the return avoids turning it into a weaker descent-heavy loop.

documents.name: LA VIE Bistro Beef Shop
documents.summary: A compact Vinohrady steak bistro built around dry-aged beef from the operator’s own herd, with enough current enthusiast praise to justify a targeted meat-lover detour.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Book ahead and make the beef the point of the visit: ask what cut is showing best, then choose ribeye, striploin or tenderloin rather than treating the wider menu as the attraction. The own-herd/aging proposition is unusually specific, but a recent severe steak-quality miss means the recommendation is A with medium confidence, not S.

documents.name: Rýchory–Dvorský les–Sklenářovice traverse
documents.summary: A quieter eastern-Krkonoše traverse through old beech woodland, mountain meadows, wetlands, mining traces and the vanished settlement landscape of Sklenářovice.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Normally an A/D2 route, but peak beech colour combined with mist or low cloud can make the forest atmosphere worth a cross-country trip. It is much quieter and more enclosed than the iconic central-Krkonoše ridge experience.

documents.name: Onigirazu
documents.summary: A vegan Holešovice takeaway window for Japanese-style rice-and-nori sandwiches that is genuinely useful for a fast, light meal when the batch is fresh.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Choose it when already around Letná/Holešovice and you need a fast vegan rice-based meal: buy one or two fresh-looking sandwiches earlier in the day, especially tempeh/spinach or Spring. Do not make a late-evening special trip because pre-prepared batches can deteriorate.

documents.name: Muggendorfer Gebürg cave-and-karst circuit
documents.summary: A limestone-karst circuit where naturally passable caves, collapsed terrain and rock formations are part of the walking route itself.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A rare coherent non-technical cave-and-karst hike and one of Franconian Switzerland’s best alternatives to more climbing-oriented routes.

documents.name: Padrť ponds and vanished-villages loop
documents.summary: A long but easy Brdy circuit through a broad mountain basin, two major ponds and the legible empty landscape of villages erased by the former military area.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A/D2 rather than merely a pleasant Brdy outing: the landscape is spacious and quiet, while the historical-map layer remains readable for hours instead of collapsing into one memorial plaque. It is difficult to substitute with a closer generic forest walk.

documents.name: Falladas Fridolinwanderung
documents.summary: A lowland lake-and-forest circuit made memorable by a hand-operated cable ferry across a narrow glacial lake.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A strong in-region discovery rather than a Germany-wide destination hike, but valuable because it represents a genuinely distinctive lowland experience.

documents.name: Rozhledna Zlatý Chlum
documents.summary: A 26 m stone lookout above Jeseník that rewards a real uphill walk with broad views over the Jeseníky and into Polish Silesia.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A satisfying walking target above Jeseník when visibility is good and the tower is confirmed open.

documents.summary: A Moravian Karst circuit approaching Macocha through the long limestone corridor of Pustý žleb rather than reducing the day to the sinkhole viewpoint.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The gorge approach turns Macocha into part of a complete karst hike rather than a short visitor stop.

documents.whyWorthwhile: A varied low-crowd valley walk with a strong architectural and viewpoint combination.

documents.summary: A long coastal footpath along the UNESCO chalk-and-limestone cliff from Rødvig past Højerup and Stevns Fyr toward Bøgeskov Havn.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A rare route where world-class geology, sea views and cultural history remain present across a substantial walk, with an especially strong southern section.

documents.summary: A rugged Oslava circuit through narrow riverside terrain, abandoned mill sites and the elevated Velká skála viewpoint.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Rough river terrain and old mill sites create a distinctly different Moravian valley hike.

documents.name: Klintekongens Rige
documents.summary: A demanding Møns Klint loop through chalk cliffs, old beech forest, grassland, Liselund and an optional shore-level cliff section.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Denmark's clearest S-tier hike: internationally distinctive geology is sustained by a varied, almost road-free walking route rather than one famous viewpoint.

documents.whyWorthwhile: The gorge offers substantially more hiking substance than many Czech waterfall outings and earns its longer Prague journey. The walking itself remains the attraction rather than merely transportation to one photogenic cascade.

documents.name: Drbákov–Albertovy skály cliff loop
documents.summary: A compact but rugged Vltava cliff traverse whose chains, rocky forest trail and six viewpoints deliver substantially more hiking intensity than its short distance suggests.
documents.whyWorthwhile: One of the strongest Prague-return anomalies in the research: roughly D1 travel friction for a D2-quality hiking experience. It is more intimate and physically engaging than many better-known Vltava viewpoints while still fitting into a half-day.

documents.name: Hillbilly

documents.whyWorthwhile: It is substantially richer than visiting Königsstuhl alone and represents Germany’s strongest combination of forest and active cliff coast in one continuous hike.

documents.name: Klíč circuit

documents.name: Obří důl–Sněžka circuit
documents.summary: A Sněžka ascent through the glacial Obří důl, where relief, avalanche gullies and mining history make the approach as important as the summit.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The glacial valley gives the Sněžka ascent sustained landscape interest before the summit itself.

documents.name: Großer Falkenstein via Höllbachgespreng
documents.localName: Durchs Höllbachgespreng auf den Großen Falkenstein
documents.summary: A rugged old-growth forest loop climbing through the boulder-filled Höllbachgespreng ravine to Großer Falkenstein.
documents.whyWorthwhile: An unusually wild Bavarian Forest journey where waterfalls, gneiss blocks and old-growth atmosphere make the trail itself far more memorable than a direct summit approach.

documents.name: Schrammsteine via Wildschützensteig
documents.summary: A sandstone route where ladders, steep stairs and narrow passages are part of the experience, culminating in one of Saxon Switzerland’s strongest ridge viewpoints.
documents.whyWorthwhile: It beats a simple Bastei visit because the hiker physically moves through the sandstone architecture. The route is exceptionally memorable without requiring climbing equipment.

documents.summary: A steep old-beech-forest circuit through granite boulders, crags and the UNESCO-listed Jizera Mountains beech landscape, with an exceptional autumn transformation.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Already A/D2 in ordinary season; at peak beech colour the combination of old forest, steep relief, granite and low autumn light can reach S-like experiential quality and D4 drive-worthiness. It is one of the few Czech seasonal transformations worth structuring a weekend around.

documents.summary: A modest traditional pub with a genuinely destination-worthy signature dish.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The quarter duck is stuffed with potato pancakes, so the rendered fat seasons the filling; sauerkraut supplies the needed acidity. It remained exceptionally inexpensive on the verification date. Order: Čtvrtka dozlatova pečené kachničky plněné bramborovými plackami a kysaným zelím; optionally beef broth or tripe soup. Why: The duck has a longstanding dish-specific reputation and was still listed for 209 CZK on the dated 2026-08-07 menu.

documents.summary: A hidden Vinohrady tearoom built for hours rather than minutes, with barefoot cushion nests, bell service, carefully selected tea and unusually strong repeat/long-stay behavior.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The A case is experiential: current first-hand accounts include near-daily visits over several weeks, explicit wishes to return every day and hours-long stays. Combined with a carefully curated tea list and genuinely unusual seating/service format, that is stronger behavioral evidence than a generic cozy-café recommendation.

documents.whyWorthwhile: A/D2 for roughly D1 travel friction. It gives much of the sandstone-world feeling associated with famous Czech rock cities while being quieter, stranger and more exploratory, without needing technical climbing or entry into unsafe military ruins.
